---
package: "openpipeline"
version: "v4.2.0"
title: "score_genes_cell_cycle_scanpy"
subtitle: "openpipeline v4.2.0"
toc: true
namespace: "Feature annotation"
description: "Calculates the score associated to S phase and G2M phase and annotates the cell cycle phase for each cell, as implemented by scanpy. The score is the average expression of a set of genes subtracted with the average expression of a reference set of genes."
type: "module"
latest: "true"
---

### Gene list inputs

The gene list inputs can be provided as a list of gene symbols or as a file containing a list of gene symbols. The gene list file should be formatted as a single column with gene symbols.

Make sure that the gene list inputs are consistent with the gene names in the adata object as provided by the --var_gene_names argument.

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/feature_annotation/score_genes_cell_cycle_scanpy/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/feature_annotation/score_genes_cell_cycle_scanpy);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/feature_annotation/score_genes_cell_cycle_scanpy/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
